description: Test file for WebSocket plugin adapter in the focalboard server, focusing on team subscriptions, user reconnections, and connection management.

classes.name: PluginAdapterClient
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket client connection with user and team subscriptions.

methods.name: TestPluginAdapterTeamSubscription
methods.description: Tests adding, subscribing, unsubscribing, and connection state changes for team WebSocket connections.

methods.name: TestPluginAdapterClientReconnect
methods.description: Tests user reconnection logic, including handling of stale connections and subscriptions.

methods.name: TestGetUserIDsForTeam
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user IDs associated with a team, considering active connections and permissions.

methods.name: TestGetUserIDsForTeamAndBoard
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user IDs for a specific team and board, including membership and access checks.

methods.name: TestParallelSubscriptionsOnMultipleConnections
methods.description: Checks concurrent subscription and unsubscription behavior across multiple WebSocket connections.
